purpose: Teach: まなざし/哀しい/長続き/パラパラ/ふい/呆然と/生れ/ただ今

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のまなざし、本気っぽいぞ
lines.en: Riku, you've got that serious look in your eyes right now.
lines.style: Observant, caught him in something. Soft challenge underneath. Slight tilt of the head. Not quite teasing, not quite sincere — right in between.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、映画で哀しいシーンになると泣くよな、桜
lines.en: You cry at sad movie scenes, don't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Deflecting with a half-smile. Light, almost affectionate callout. Turns it back on her before she can dig deeper. Voice stays easy, not defensive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前と部活、長続きしてんな
lines.en: Riku, you're actually sticking with your club. That's surprising.
lines.style: Genuine underneath the sarcasm. Warm acknowledgment wrapped in teasing. Eyes soften a bit. The kind of compliment a friend gives without making it obvious.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストでパラパラ間違えたな、桜
lines.en: You messed up some questions on the test, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Casual turnabout. Matching her rhythm, her tone. A gentle jab back. No malice — just the easy back-and-forth of people who know each other.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ふいに俺の家来んなよ
lines.en: Riku, don't just show up at my place out of nowhere like that.
lines.style: Half-exasperated, half-something else underneath. Tests the boundaries. Voice stays light but there's a real request in there. Not angry — more like she's protecting something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、成績見て呆然と固まってたな、桜
lines.en: You just stood there frozen when you saw your grades, didn't you.
lines.style: Softer now. Observing rather than teasing. Gentle return volley. The tone says he saw her, and he's okay with it. Voice quiets slightly on the image.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、お前が生れた家だろ?
lines.en: Riku, isn't that house where you were born? Your home?
lines.style: Asking something real this time. Dropped the deflection. Curious, almost vulnerable. Small pause before the question. Waiting for an honest answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ただ今帰った、って一応言えよ、桜
lines.en: You could at least say 'I'm home' when you walk in, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet suggestion with weight underneath. Not a lecture — more like he's saying something that matters to him. Simple, direct, voice steady.
